content:
emily_ar: Heads-up: VaultBridge (INV-2026-1104) hit an ACH return for $14,750. Return code R29 (NSF). Batch ach_12098 failed.
maria_billing: bummer. any saved card on file?
zoe_support: account shows a card token but it's expired (11/2025). customer emailed: CFO says they're mid-bank-migration and requested a temporary payment plan to avoid collections. offered 40% today, remainder in 30/60 days. attached their request.
ben_collections: policy = one manual ACH retry for R29. For multi-payments need finance + legal signoff and a signed agreement. Also require autopay or card token for subsequent charges.
lena_legal: legal can approve a 3-part plan with a clause preserving our right to collect if a payment fails. need signed installment agreement and explicit card fallback consent.
maria_billing: finance will approve waiving one late fee if they provide a signed agreement and put card on file. we'll allow a single manual retry prior to charging card.
collections_bot: Action: invoice INV-2026-1104 placed into "negotiation_hold". Dunning paused until 2026-04-28.
emily_ar: called the CFO; got verbal commitment for 40% today and to upload signed agreement + tokenized card by EOD. scheduling manual retry for 2026-04-21 08:30 PT. logging MANUAL_RETRY_EMILY.
zoe_support: sent payment link + installment template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/installment-agreement. requested card token and signed PDF. customer replied they will sign and upload by tonight. :thumbsup:
maria_billing: reconciliation snapshot queued:
account,invoice,amount,status
VaultBridge,INV-2026-1104,14750,return_R29
ben_collections: once we receive the signed docs and card token, schedule ad-hoc charge for 40% ($5,900). if ACH retry clears, treat as settlement and cancel card charge.
emily_ar: noted. will post signed PDF when received. also set AR watch and reminder for 2026-05-22 to confirm final settlement.
lena_legal: uploaded consent template link: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/ach-consent. confirm clause about renewal protections removed (customer asked for assurance). legal says no changes to renewal language without contract amendment.
zoe_support: customer uploaded signed agreement and card tokenized. they also asked for written confirmation that we won't pause service during the plan. i confirmed service remains active.
maria_billing: scheduled manual retry 2026-04-21 08:30 PT. ledger action: "PAYMENT_PLAN_CREATED". assigning to emily_ar for monitoring.
collections_bot: Reminder set: check_INV-2026-1104 on 2026-04-28.
emily_ar: performed manual retry; ACH returned again R29 at 2026-04-21T08:31Z. proceeding to charge card token for $5,900 as approved. logged TRANSACTION token_charge_7782 status: success.
maria_billing: recorded PARTIAL_PAYMENT $5,900 received via card at 2026-04-21T08:45Z. updated ledger:
account,invoice,amount,status
VaultBridge,INV-2026-1104,14750,partial_paid_5900
ben_collections: great. remind customer payment schedule: remaining amounts due 2026-05-21 ($4,425) and 2026-06-20 ($4,425). autopay required for those dates.
emily_ar: customer acknowledged schedule and autopay. leaving thread open for final payments. closing ts 2005007120
